description: Ensures PayPal best practices are consulted before generating integration code

hooks.prompt: If this file edit involves PayPal SDK, API calls, checkout, payments, or PayPal integration code: you MUST first load the paypal-best-practices skill and check the SDK version routing table before proceeding. Detect whether the project uses v5 (paypal.Buttons, sdk/js?client-id=) or v6 (createInstance, web-sdk/v6/core), then read the correct reference file. Return 'approve' to proceed.
